title: 2027 IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory (ISIT 2027)
about: ISIT 2027, the IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory, takes place 27 June to 2 July 2027 in Sorrento, Italy. Paper submissions are due 10 January 2027, 23:59 Anywhere on Earth; acceptance notifications follow on 27 March 2027.
